task_name: Add data-testid contract to critical pages

concerns_addressed: Added required data-testid attributes across all 5 critical UI surfaces (LoginForm, OrderForm, admin orders, delivery, payments, orders page wrapper) matching the spec and execution plan.
No business logic, handlers, or API integration code altered — strictly attribute-only additions.
Corresponding unit/component tests added (*.testid.spec.tsx) for LoginForm, OrderForm, AdminOrdersPage, DeliveryPage, and PaymentsPage, verifying the presence of all testids under test doubles.
Existing guards (isDummy, installDummy) and component structure fully preserved.
All 8 new tests PASS (verified via `npx jest --runInBand` from apps/web).

stage_2.assessment: Approved. The data-testid contract additions are clean, atomic, and strictly adhere to the attribute-only constraint without touching handlers or logic. Comprehensive component tests (*.testid.spec.tsx) prove the selectors are correctly exposed and resilient.

issues.description: Component test files duplicate some setup/mock boilerplate across the 5 surfaces, but each is self-contained and scoped directly to its respective route/component.
orders-page data-testid added to OrdersPage wrapper but no dedicated test file (apps/web/src/app/orders/page.testid.spec.tsx) exists; T6 E2E test uses it as primary selector so contract is exercised.

Optional order-status-badge and order-toast testids (spec open question: 'where applicable') not added; T6 review accepts CSS fallback (StatusBadge has no testid, toast uses presence assertion). Falls within spec flexibility.

strengths: Strict adherence to architecture constraint: git diff confirms zero logic/handler changes across apps/web/src/components and apps/web/src/app.

Complete test coverage for all specified testids: login-email, login-password, login-submit, login-error; order-submit, order-success, order-track-input, order-track-submit; admin-orders-table, admin-order-approve-{id}, admin-order-detail-{id}, admin-orders-error; delivery-start-{id}, delivery-recipient-{id}, delivery-proof-url-{id}, delivery-complete-{id}; payment-order-id, payment-amount, payment-submit, payment-success.
Kebab-case naming consistency maintained across all testids.
Atomic commit corresponding to task requirements.
All new component tests pass in isolation.
